adaptations: Desktop fine-pointer trigger strings are shown; all source long-press strings are retained in target accessibility descriptions and the RTL translation model. No touch long-press recognizer is added.
Docs triggers preserve dashed radius-12 16:9 max-width-320 geometry; Create triggers preserve solid radius-8 4:1 geometry, with responsive side grid.
Material Symbols outline SVGs replace equivalent source icon placeholders; Native route uses shared template native menu images through NewMenuIconSVG. No icon font or network asset.
Flyout uses desktop.ContextMenu in an independent child window; Native uses desktop.NativeContextMenu and keeps OS styling and placement. NativeOS ignores requested CSS width/inset/side.
Shortcut strings are visible hints, not host-application keyboard commands. All leaves update local application values/status; no file, clipboard, browser or deletion side effect.
Source defaults and disabled states survive; controlled static demo check/radio examples receive local editable state for interactive Gallery use.
Inset and GroupInset map source logical-start padding; checkbox/radio reserve logical end for system/style appropriate checks.

Source styled checkbox/radio default closeOnClick=false is preserved; action defaults close. NativeOS tracking follows system behavior. The headless submenu canvas is enlarged explicitly because the injected Backend does not run the native FitContent sizing loop.

MenuItem.SubmenuWidth preserves the docs Demo/RTL w-44 subpanels at 176 DIPs beneath the 192-DIP root; unspecified panels inherit the shared MenuProps.Width, with a 4-DIP adjacent gap in either reading direction. Native OS menus ignore visual widths.
